nightline

Nightline runs small jobs on a schedule while your laptop sleeps. It wakes the machine, runs what is due, and goes back to sleep without leaving a background process behind.

Installation

Install the command line tool with your package manager, then register the wake helper once.

brew install nightline
nightline setup

Why another scheduler?

Most schedulers assume the computer is always on. Nightline assumes it is usually asleep, which changes how missed jobs, retries and battery use should work.

  • Missed jobs run once at the next wake, not once per missed slot.
  • Retries back off exponentially and stop after a day.

About

A tiny scheduler for overnight jobs
